t.name: Cedar Creek Trail
t.description: The trail continues 7.5 miles beyond the falls to Abernathy Pass, where it enters the Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Wilderness and ends at North Creek Trail #413.

t.name: Driveway Butte Trail
t.description: The trail follows an old skid road uphill for an half mile then becomes more of a trail as it heads up towards a small pass. From the pass at 2.2 miles to the open meadows at 4 miles, the trail is within the 2003 Needle Creek Fire perimeter.

t.name: Early Winters Trail
t.description: This forested trail leaves Klipchuck Campground between spaces 7 and 8, and follows the north side of Early Winters Creek. The trail remains mostly level for 4 miles until it reaches State Route 20, directly across from Silver Star Creek.
